title: Tensor powers of module isomorphisms, with the canonical pullback power comparisons
statement: For a scheme $Z$ and sheaves of modules $A,B$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], use the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and recursively define $A^{\otimes0}=\mathcal O_Z$ and $A^{\otimes(d+1)}=A\otimes A^{\otimes d}$. For an isomorphism $t:A\simeq B$, define $t^{\otimes d}:A^{\otimes d}\simeq B^{\otimes d}$ for every $d\geq0$ by $t^{\otimes0}=\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal O_Z}$ and $t^{\otimes(d+1)}=t\otimes t^{\otimes d}$. These powers are used together with the recursive pullback power comparisons $p_j(L,d):j^*(L^{\otimes d})\simeq(j^*L)^{\otimes d}$ of [def-sc-tensor-pullback-power-comparison] for module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] along an arbitrary scheme morphism $j$; this node adds only the powers of an isomorphism. Neither invertibility, a closed immersion, nor a square-zero ideal is required.
